name: Telegram Owner All Branches Ready Reports

parameters.content:
## Telegram Owner Reports
يرسل للمالك رابط تقرير جاهز لكل الأفرع.

Required n8n Variables:
- REPORT_APP_BASE_URL
- REPORT_API_TOKEN
- TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN
- REPORT_OWNER_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID

Backend must have same REPORT_API_TOKEN in .env.

Reports:
- Daily all branches
- Weekly all branches
- Monthly all branches
